sketches.mechanism: An undefined external symbol declared weak does not cause a link error; its address can be null at runtime.
sketches.resonance: The program is permitted to continue around an absent power, testing for presence before it dares to call.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever, because no sender can ever rendezvous with it.
sketches.resonance: A waiting place with no other side becomes an eternal vigil rather than an error.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the object leaves its last strong scope.
sketches.resonance: What is not held strongly enough may vanish without breaking anything, leaving only absence in the variable meant to remember.
